components.text:
The Ritual of the Feathered Knife automatically draws $(blood)LP$() from a player standing near it and deposits it into a linked Blood Altar, much like an automated Sacrificial Knife. Tier 0, costs $(blood)25,000 LP$() to activate.
Use a Ritual Diviner [Dusk] for easier construction.

Various Demon Will types can be channeled into this ritual via the Aura to change its behavior, and Runes of Self Sacrifice and the Living Armour upgrade Tough Palms both affect how much is drawn per tick. Check the ritual's tooltip in-game (via the Ritual Diviner or a Divination Sigil) for the exact current bonuses on this branch.
